senses.gloss: m. (<cite ref="U01158"><he>שכל</he></cite>, Shaf. of <cite ref="K00259"><he>כּוּל</he></cite>; cmp. <cite ref="M01379"><he>מְכִילָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01379"><he>מְכִילְתָּא</he></cite>)

units: <cite ref="Shabbat 77b:10">Sabb. 77ᵇ</cite> (phonetic etymol.) <he>מ׳ מאשי כולא</he> ‘washing everybody’, contrad. to <cite ref="M02902"><he>משכילתא</he></cite>: <he>משיא כלתא</he> ‘washing brides’ (distinguished people).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 39a:10">Ab. Zar. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ חיורי</he> white (glazed) basins.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b:1">B. Mets. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>שיתין מ׳ דמא</he> sixty basin-fuls of blood.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 18b:2">M. Kat. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ דמני וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. sing.) basins filled with linen garments (for rinsing in the lake).

<cite ref="Gittin 69b:19">Gitt. 69ᵇ</cite> bot.—Fem. form (<cite ref="M02902"><he>מַשְׁכִּילְתָּא</he></cite>) <cite ref="M02882"><he>מְשִׁיכְלְתָא</he></cite>. Sabb. l. c. <he>משיכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>משכיל׳</he>), v. supra.
<cite ref="Chullin 47b:9">Ḥull. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>משיכותא דמיא וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) a basin of tepid water.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 51b:14">Ab. Zar. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>דסחיפא ליה מ׳ ארישיה</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8) the idolatrous statuary has an inverted washbasin on its head.

senses.gloss: (cmp. כֶּלִי, מָאן as vessel and garment) a sort of cloak.
units: Lev. R. s. 23 (expl. שמיכה, Jud. IV, 18) רבנן … ורבנן דתמן אמרי במ׳ the rabbis here (in Palestine) say, it means with a sudra (סוּדְרָא), while the Babylonian rabbis say m’shikhla; Yalk. Jud. 44; Yalk. Lev. 585.
